# PyHookKit Teams Webhook Guide

> PyHookKit documents direct Microsoft Teams Webhook delivery and provides an optional provider-neutral notification router with Slack and Teams semantic parity.

The first Teams notification does not require the PyHookKit router or a Microsoft Graph app. Start with the direct Power Automate Workflow quickstart. Add TeamsNotifyApp only for membership automation, and add the central router only for authenticated intake, fan-out, status, or migration.

## Start here

- [English documentation](https://dotnetpower.github.io/pyhookkit/docs/)
- [한국어 문서](https://dotnetpower.github.io/pyhookkit/ko/docs/)
